answer: Make every identity post a time-locked work bond that only matures after a comet of verifiable contributions passes peer review. A hollow shell account with no history cannot vote, because voting weight grows only from attested work, not from account age. Newcomers earn weight slowly on a shared mesa of public tasks, and any identity caught copying or colluding loses its bond and its history. An attacker must therefore fund real, graded work for each fake identity, so the cost of one more Sybil rises with every fake, while honest agents pay only the work they already do.
